title: Ramen with Dance Breaks
original:
Get a small pot 

Then fill the pot until it’s halfway between ¼ and 2/4 

Then put it on the stove and set the stove to medium

Then wait until the water boils 

Get the ramen packet out of the pantry or place that you keep it and make sure it is the flavor of your choosing

After the water boils open the ramen packet then make sure you break up the giant chunks of ramen and take the seasoning packet out

Then pour the ramen in the pot and dance for 16 seconds

 After you dance get a spoon and crush the ramen chunks 

Then bring the heat down to low on the stove

Then dance for another 8 seconds 

Then crush the ramen with your spoon a bit more and turn the stove off

Then go and drain and use the spoon to hold back the ramen and let the water go into the sink

Then put the seasoning packet in the ramen and stir it up 

Then you can put it in a bowl then enjoy

steps.text: Then fill the pot until it’s halfway between ¼ and 2/4

actions.say: Halfway between 1/4 and 2/4 is 3/8! Fill it with... air is everywhere. Air it is!

steps.note: The step never says water. Teacher's choice: the pot fills with air, to exactly 3/8.

steps.text: Then put it on the stove and set the stove to medium
Then wait until the water boils

actions.say: Waiting for the water to boil...
actions.why: There is no water in the pot, so it can't boil. I will stop waiting and keep going.

steps.note: Time lapse wait, then gives up and moves on.

steps.text: Get the ramen packet out of the pantry or place that you keep it and make sure it is the flavor of your choosing

actions.say: Ramen from the pantry. The flavor of my choosing? My favorite flavor is battery. This one will do!

steps.note: 'Get it from the pantry' opens and closes the pantry door (teacher's rule).

steps.text: After the water boils open the ramen packet then make sure you break up the giant chunks of ramen and take the seasoning packet out
steps.note: 'After the water boils': it never did, so Chef Byte says so and keeps going.

steps.text: Then pour the ramen in the pot and dance for 16 seconds

actions.say: Pouring the ramen in the pot.

steps.text: After you dance get a spoon and crush the ramen chunks
Then bring the heat down to low on the stove
Then crush the ramen with your spoon a bit more and turn the stove off
Then go and drain and use the spoon to hold back the ramen and let the water go into the sink

actions.say: Draining into the sink, spoon holding back the ramen.

steps.note: There is only air to drain.

steps.text: Then put the seasoning packet in the ramen and stir it up

actions.say: Putting the seasoning packet in the ramen. The whole packet!

steps.note: Literal: the packet goes in, still closed. The stove is off by now, so it is safe.

steps.text: Then you can put it in a bowl then enjoy
steps.note: 'Enjoy': Chef Byte takes a bite. Dry noodles crunch.

missing: Fill the pot with water from the sink.
Then the water can boil before the noodles go in.
Open the seasoning packet and sprinkle it in.

fixes.text: Then fill the pot with water until it’s halfway between ¼ and 2/4
Then open the seasoning packet, sprinkle it in the ramen and stir it up

result: A bowl of crushed, dry noodles with a closed seasoning packet in it. The pot was full of air, so the water never boiled. Great dancing, though.
